submitted.rationale: Every measured EQE is near zero, which fits Mg–Sb–O being a wide-gap system that barely absorbs 2.4 eV photons. The signal rises slightly and monotonically with Sb fraction: 0.00007% at 0.555, 0.00016% at 0.670 and 0.00025% at 0.757. The most Sb-rich composition, index 26, gave the highest value measured.
